Searching comprehensively for every reference to the Go struct `store.Memo` across `/bench/repo`, distinguishing internal definitions from external usages, and returning only evidence-backed paths with exact reference notes.

The search will be organized into four categories: the struct definition, internal unqualified references, external explicit references grouped by package, and implicit usages where `*Memo` values are handled without explicit type annotations. This last category is included because any change to `store.Memo` would still require field-level review even when the type is not explicitly named.

Explicit `store.Memo` references were found in the store package itself, the sqlite and postgres database drivers, the notification service, the memopayload runner, the RSS router, the API v1 router, the test package, and the frontend router. Implicit `*Memo` usages appear in the fileserver router and the production frontend router. The memo_service_comments package is the same as api/v1.
